name: feishu-codex-bridge
description: Connect Feishu to Codex on your Windows PC. 飞书连接本机 Codex。

interface.longDescription:
Run Codex tasks from Feishu, with persistent conversations, files, approval cards and an independent Windows background service.
通过飞书使用本机 Codex：连续会话、文件交付、授权卡片和独立后台运行。Windows x64 only. Requires your own Codex account and Feishu application. / 需要你自己的 Codex 账号与飞书应用。
interface.defaultPrompt: 帮我初始化飞书 Codex 桥接，一步步引导我完成配置。
